name: choruz-ci-test-reliability
title_zh: 共享一个数据库的并行测试，谁在偷偷改你的数据
tagline_zh: 本地跑十遍全绿，CI 上随机红一条——多半不是代码坏了，是 Playwright 多 worker 共用一个 Po…
tagline_en: Green ten times locally, one random red in CI — usually not your code, but parallel Playwright workers sharing.
desc_en: Design, review, and diagnose Choruz tests and fixtures that can fail nondeterministically under CI concurrency: parallel Playwright workers sharing one PostgreSQL and one API, vitest workers, cargo tests on a shared test database, clocks, ports, and asynchronous teardown. Use when adding or changing tests with those risks, investigating a flaky CI run, or reviewing test isolation.
why_zh: 它按「共享资源」而不是按「测试文件」来审：先列出谁共用了哪个库、哪个端口、哪个时钟。
why_en: It reviews by shared resource, not by test file: first list who shares which database, port, or clock, then judge whether the.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Choruz 那套栈：Playwright 并行 worker、vitest、cargo 测试共用一个测试库。
limit_en: Only covers the Choruz stack: parallel Playwright workers, vitest, cargo tests on one shared test DB. Other frameworks or isolation schemes are out.
title_en: Parallel tests sharing one database: who's mutating your.
